purpose: Test whether a compact causal model can distinguish an economically meaningful upward path, downward path, or neutral/unresolvable path before loops or setup dictionaries are considered.

opened_data_status.warning: All source periods have participated elsewhere in the research lineage. This is a frozen causal retrospective development test only.

data.off_grid_policy: Exclude and count rows not exactly on the five-minute regular-session grid; never round timestamps.
data.aal_2026_reason: Preserve the existing frozen 2026 source boundary after terminal AAL rows were previously exposed during schema inspection.

population.reason: Two predeclared non-overlapping 24-bar outcome windows per complete regular session avoid setup-selection bias and overlapping labels.
requirements: exact decision bar exists on grid
the prior 12 bars are contiguous within the same session segment
all elapsed regular-session bars from ordinal 0 through the decision bar are present because session-return, session-mean, and opening-range features use them
all OHLC values are finite, positive, and internally ordered
causal prior scale is finite and positive
population.post_seal_path_policy: After the outcome-free population is hashed, require the next-open admission bar and all 24 outcome bars to be exact and contiguous; retain and count any population row that cannot be scored.

causal_clock.decision: Features and class probabilities use the completed decision bar and earlier data only.
causal_clock.admission: Economic translation begins at the exact next provider open; this is a research counterfactual only.
causal_clock.outcome: Future highs, lows, closes, class labels, barrier hits, and payoffs remain sealed until the pre-outcome ledger and hashes are written.
causal_clock.training: A scored session may use labels only from completed earlier sessions; no same-session label enters fitting.

target.name: symmetric_causal_scale_triple_barrier_24
target.prior_scale_bps: Median true-range bps of the prior 12 contiguous completed bars, excluding the decision bar.
target.barrier_rationale: A four-bar-range scale asks for a substantial horizon move while preserving a genuine no-touch neutral class; the multiple and clamps are frozen rather than outcome-selected.
target.long: The upper barrier is uniquely touched before the lower barrier.
target.short: The lower barrier is uniquely touched before the upper barrier.
target.neutral: Neither barrier is touched within 24 bars, or the first boundary interaction touches both barriers in the same five-minute bar and cannot be ordered.
target.same_bar_dual_touch: Label neutral/unresolvable for classification and score either hypothetical directional position conservatively as a stop loss.
target.gap_rule: A bar open beyond one barrier establishes that barrier first; an open cannot be beyond both symmetric barriers.
target.no_touch_economic_exit: Exit a hypothetical directional position at the close of outcome bar 24.
target.accuracy_warning: Neutral means no uniquely observable usable direction under this bar resolution; it does not mean the price was literally flat.

causal_features.activity_caveat: Both activity fields use provider historical bar volume as an activity proxy only.
excluded: loop scores or realised loop identity
quotes, ticks, spread, order book, broker, position, and order state

model_fit.numeric_preprocessing: training-window median imputation followed by standard scaling
model_fit.categorical_preprocessing: one-hot encoding with unknown levels ignored
model_fit.refit: Every scored session using only prior completed sessions across 2024 onward.

outputs.classification_state: Argmax of the three probabilities, with deterministic class-name tie breaking.

economic_state.state: Choose the higher positive directional proxy EV; otherwise neutral.
economic_state.warning: The proxy treats neutral gross payoff as zero. Actual path payoff is evaluated separately and governs conclusions.

economic_scoring.same_bar_dual_touch: negative barrier_bps gross before cost for either direction
economic_scoring.no_touch: signed close-24 return from entry before cost
economic_scoring.neutral_prediction: zero payoff and no hypothetical position

economic_metrics: mean net bps per directional output
mean net bps per full eligible opportunity
evaluation.multiplicity: Holm control across both score periods for M1 versus M0, M2 versus M1, and the economic-policy endpoints.
qualification: Macro-F1 improvement over M0 has a paired session-block lower bound above zero in both score periods.
Log-loss improvement over M0 is positive in both periods and survives Holm control.
Both long and short output precision are at least 55% in both periods.
Economic directional mean net has a session-block lower bound above zero in both periods.
Full-opportunity mean net remains positive at 7.5 bps per side in both periods.
At least half of months are positive and every leave-one-stock-out deletion remains positive in both periods.
Coverage, stock breadth, exact rerun, leakage, and independent audit gates pass.
evaluation.decision: Any failed qualification gate yields rejected_or_descriptive_only; no retrospective model may be promoted.

hypotheses.question: Does compact causal price geometry improve long/short/neutral discrimination over clock-specific prior probabilities?
hypotheses.expected_research_benefit: Separates direction learnability from loop occurrence and entry-pattern selection.
hypotheses.safety_risk: A high neutral prevalence could inflate headline accuracy.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Reject unless macro F1 and log loss improve portably, with class-specific metrics reported.

hypotheses.question: Does causal historical-volume activity add information after price context?
hypotheses.expected_research_benefit: Tests one compact information increment instead of a large sparse dictionary.
hypotheses.safety_risk: Provider volume may be mistaken for quote flow or order-book participation.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Reject the increment if it does not improve both score periods after multiplicity control.

hypotheses.question: Can three-state probabilities support a cost-aware long/short/neutral decision with positive realised path payoff?
hypotheses.expected_research_benefit: Prevents forced direction and connects classification to actual post-cost paths.
hypotheses.safety_risk: The proxy EV simplifies neutral-path magnitude and cannot establish a tradable rule by itself.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Reject unless realised rather than proxy payoff passes every economic gate.

hypotheses.question: Is any detected edge present in both long and short states rather than one period-specific side?
hypotheses.expected_research_benefit: Distinguishes genuine direction classification from a market-drift shortcut.
hypotheses.safety_risk: Short counterfactuals omit borrow availability and fees.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Reject qualification if either side misses frozen precision or support gates.

required: all path labels and payoffs independently replayed
